text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that was so close!
Just a little bit more, too!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You were on quite the right track, but
you've still got a long way to go to compete with me♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, but seeing you work so hard and seriously
was really cool!
It ended in a disappointing result...
